notes: Comcast's FY2025 10-K gives no employee, store or network figures by state or country. The only geographic workforce figure is that approximately 30% of its ~179,000 employees (FTE basis, Dec 31, 2025) were in over 30 countries outside the U.S., recorded as one region; the filing names the UK, Western Europe, East Asia and South Asia as larger concentrations without numbers. Sites are those Item 2 (Properties) and the Theme Parks segment description name. The CNBC headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ was removed: the 10-K says it 'is owned by Versant following the Separation on January 2, 2026'. Universal Orlando now includes Epic Universe, opened in May 2025. A web search in the earlier edition found only older, partial state fact sheets (e.g. Utah 2016, New Mexico 2017); no newer state-by-state impact report was found (checked 2026-11-24), so no state rows are recorded. Period: Dec 31, 2025.
